name: Submetering and billing service for landlords
summary: A provider installs radio meters in every unit, reads them remotely and prepares consumption-based heating and water billing for landlords and property managers.
how_it_makes_money: Service fees for metering devices, remote reading, data validation and billing. Exact fee structures are not in the sources and should be added.

hardware: Wireless meters and heat cost allocators
regulation: Heating cost ordinance and national billing and remote-reading rules

stakeholder_value.customer: Landlord: compliant billing without on-site visits
stakeholder_value.provider: Recurring service revenue with high switching effort for customers

what_must_be_true: Regulation requires consumption-based billing and remote reading

risks_failure_causes.text: The Bundeskartellamt examined the market, which is dominated by a few large players
Customers report misread radio meters and weak support when billing is wrong

cases.note: According to the Bundeskartellamt the two share 50 to 60 percent of the German market. Techem serves more than 13 million apartments and reports about 85 percent wireless reading.
